summary: Fed Cup is the premier international team competition in women's tennis, launched in 1963 for the 50th anniversary of the International Tennis Federation. It was called the Federation Cup until 1995 and is the world's largest annual women's international team sports competition by number of nations. Katrina Adams is the current chairperson.
one_line: Fed Cup, formerly the Federation Cup, is women's tennis's premier international team competition, launched in 1963 by the ITF and led by Katrina Adams.
key_facts: Fed Cup is the premier international team competition in women's tennis.
The competition was launched to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the International Tennis Federation (ITF).
Fed Cup was known as the Federation Cup until 1995.
Fed Cup is the world's largest annual women's international team sports competition in terms of the number of nations that compete.
The current Fed Cup Chairperson is Katrina Adams.
